}}'''Burn''' is a wolf that is a part of [[Dapple]]'s pack.

==Appearance and History==
Burn received his name due to an old shoulder injury from a [[Trolloc]]. He thinks of little outside of hunting and killing [[Shadowspawn]].{{ref/book|1|23}} He is impatient, angry, and large.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Burn}}

==Activities==
Burn, along with Dapple, [[Hopper]] and [[Wind (wolf)|Wind]], speak with [[Elyas Machera]] and [[Perrin Aybara]] when Perrin is learning about being a [[wolfbrother]].{{ref/book|1|23}} Burn becomes reluctant as Dapple wants to follow the humans.{{ref/book|1|27}}
